name: Mission Lane
notes: Tier 2. Researched from Mission Lane's public help center (support.missionlane.com articles, read through the help center's public article API because the article pages refuse automated fetches; no sign-in). Sign-in at dashboard.missionlane.com with email address and password, button 'Log In'. Payment: dashboard 'Make a Payment' > payment amount > payment date > payment source > 'Review Payment' > 'Submit Payment'; checking accounts are added with 'Add a checking account' (routing and account numbers). Only checking accounts are described (a debit card is used only for the security deposit), so methods are bank only. Auto Pay: 'Auto Pay' under the Make Payment button > Payment Amount, Payment date and funding account ('Pay from') > 'Review Auto Pay' > agree to terms > 'Save Auto Pay'; also by phone Mon-Fri 9-8 ET; autopay can be cancelled or edited any time (Late Payments article). Amount options are not listed, so autopay.policies stays at the default. Cutoff: payments by 5:59 p.m. ET on the due date are on time; later payments are credited the next business day; available credit can take up to 7 calendar days to update. Due date is at least 23 days after the cycle closes; due-date change by phone only (not modelled). Paperless: enrolled by sending a message to support, not a self-service switch, so paperless is unsupported online with a note. Closing: log in and send a Secure Message, or call Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-8 p.m. ET; closed accounts cannot be reopened; secured-card deposits are refunded once the balance is paid. Mail: Mission Lane LLC, PO Box 71084, Charlotte, NC 28272-1084 (full name and 16-digit account number on the check). Phone 1-855-790-8860. Cards are issued by partner banks (TAB Bank, WebBank) and serviced by Mission Lane (catalog research). Fees: see the Cardholder Agreement; amounts are not on the help pages.

guest_pay.note: Mission Lane has no pay-without-logging-in option. Log in to pay online or in the app, call 1-855-790-8860 to pay by phone, or mail a check.

paperless.note: To switch to paperless statements, send us a quick message from your account and we'll enroll you. We'll email you when each statement is ready.

cancel_service.note: To close your account, log in and send us a Secure Message, or call 1-855-790-8860 Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET. A closed account can't be reopened.

help.title: Make a payment
paragraphs: Paying online is the fastest way. Log in with your email and password, choose Make a Payment on your dashboard, then pick the amount, the date and the payment source. Select Review Payment, check the details and select Submit Payment.
Add a checking account first with its routing and account numbers: choose Make Payment, then Add a checking account. You can also pay by phone at the number on the back of your card.
steps: Log in and choose Make a Payment.
Select the amount, date and payment source.

help.title: Enroll in Auto Pay
paragraphs: Log in and select Auto Pay under the Make Payment button. Enter the Payment Amount, the Payment date and the funding account; if no checking account is on file, add its routing and account numbers in the Pay from section.

Select Review Auto Pay, agree to the terms at the bottom and select Save Auto Pay. You can edit or cancel Auto Pay at any time. To enroll by phone, call 1-855-790-8860, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET.
steps: Log in and select Auto Pay under Make Payment.
Enter the amount, date and funding account.
Select Review Auto Pay and agree to the terms.

help.title: When your payment is due
paragraphs: Sign in to see your due date and amount owed. Submit your payment before 5:59 p.m. ET on the due date; payments submitted later are credited the next business day.
New accounts get a due date once the first statement with activity closes.

help.title: Mission Lane payment address
paragraphs: Mail a check to Mission Lane LLC, PO Box 71084, Charlotte, NC 28272-1084, with your full name and 16-digit account number. Mail can be slow, so send it well before your due date or pay online or by phone instead.

help.title: Going paperless
paragraphs: Send us a quick message to switch to paperless billing. Statements are then posted to your online dashboard the day after your billing cycle closes, and we email you when each one is ready.
Online, find past statements by selecting Statements at the bottom of Recent Activity; in the app, open the Home tab and select Statements next to Activity.

help.title: Close my account
paragraphs: Log in and send a Secure Message asking to close the account, or call the number on the back of your card Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET. Once closed, the account cannot be reopened.

help.title: If your account is past due
paragraphs: Past due means a minimum payment was missed. The card can't be used while past due, fees or interest may apply, and accounts 30 or more days past due may be reported to credit bureaus.
Even a partial payment helps. Call the number on the back of your card to talk about options.
